`gamescope/` is the keyboard/mouse gamescope fork (github.com/partydeck/gamescope), built by `packaging/scripts/build_gamescope.sh` and shipped as `bin/gamescope-kbm`.
`deps.patch` is applied on top of that submodule before building; `releases/` (gitignored) holds the Goldberg and UMU downloads made by `packaging/scripts/fetch_deps.sh`.
